thread:
incident-bot: Paging on-call SRE: routing anomaly detected for tenant=acme-corp. High error rate + 503s, unexpected spillover into Dedicated pool when tenant is supposed to be pinned to Hosted. potential impact: user-facing latency and failed requests. auto-escalate.

mike (SRE): I see the page. Confirming: metrics dashboard shows spike at 17:34 UTC, routing decisions show repeated fallback to dedicated-0 despite dedicated not having capacity.

javier (SRE): Copy. Pulling routing logs now.

mike (SRE): Logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T17:34:12Z INFO routing_decision tenant=acme-corp request_id=req_9a2 model=redwood-v1 variant=8 destination=hosted-pool
2026-03-15T17:34:12Z WARN routing_fallback tenant=acme-corp reason=capacity_threshold destination=dedicated-0 policy_id=p-reset-2026
2026-03-15T17:34:13Z WARN routing_fallback_loop tenant=acme-corp count=3
```

javier (SRE): Looks like fallback policy 'p-reset-2026' has priority list [dedicated, hosted] (oops). It should be [hosted, dedicated]. That explains the misroute. Searching policy config in git.

anna (Infra): I can patch the policy quickly if we want a hotfix. But need to coordinate with @tara for infra config push.

tara (Platform): Oncall: do not push to prod policy repo without a rollback plan. However we can apply a runtime override that pins tenant=acme-corp to hosted-pool. That's lower risk.

mike (SRE): +1 runtime override. How do we apply?

anna (Infra): Use the admin API: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/runtime-overrides \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  -d '{"tenant":"acme-corp","route":"hosted-pool","expires":"+2h","reason":"incident hotfix"}'
```

javier (SRE): Applied override at 17:37 UTC. Confirming logs now show destination=hosted-pool for new requests.

mike (SRE): Metrics look better: latency dropping, 503s subsiding. But we still see a loop in the router state machine causing retries to hit dedicated-0. Need to drain dedicated-0's queue of any misrouted sessions.

anna (Infra): Scheduling a drain: 
```bash
# mark node for no new routing targets
rbctl node annotate dedicated-0 maintenance=true
# slowly migrate active sessions off
rbctl node drain dedicated-0 --grace-period=60s
```

deploy-bot: Deploy job #4572 canceled (requested by anna).

ryan (Product): Emily, heads up — Acme support flagged increased error rates and some customer API timeouts. Do we need to proactively contact them?

emily (CS): Yes. Reach out with a brief summary and ETA. I'll draft an email once we confirm stabilization.

mike (SRE): Quick root cause summary so far: policy 'p-reset-2026' was rolled last night and accidentally reordered fallback priorities during a templating change. That made the router prefer Dedicated when capacity checks were flaky, causing tenant isolation breach (hosted-only tenant spilled into shared dedicated pool).

javier (SRE): Post-mitigation tasks: 1) revert policy change and re-run unit tests in CI; 2) add a strict test that ensures tenant pinning cannot be overridden by fallback ordering; 3) run audit for other tenants affected. I'll open the JIRA.

mike (SRE): On-call handoff incoming in 20m. @javier I'll hand to you after we confirm drains complete. If anything regresses ping @mike.

javier (SRE): Taking over. I will monitor for 1h and handle follow-ups. Key hooks: check /routes/tenant/acme-corp, routing history, and dedicated-0 drain progress.

tara (Platform): Also adding a temporary guard in the smart-router: if tenant has policy.pin=hosted then ignore fallback list entirely. I'll open a small PR and we can hotfix if needed.

mike (SRE): Noting customer impact: ~0.8% of requests for acme-corp failed during peak window (17:34-17:39). Estimated affected users: 1200 requests, most retries succeeded after override.

emily (CS): Drafted customer note: "We experienced a routing configuration issue that briefly routed some traffic to a different capacity tier. We've mitigated and are investigating cause; no customer data was exposed." Will wait for final numbers.

javier (SRE): Verified last call at 17:52 UTC shows no new misroutes. Closing active incident channel in 30m unless we see regressions.

mike (SRE): Follow-ups for postmortem: include CI policy linting, prevent fallbacks that violate tenant pins, add dashboard alert for cross-tier spillover, and a runbook for runtime override. Assign owners.

ryan (Product): Thanks all. @emily ping me when the customer note is sent.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=sev2, incident_id=INC-2026-142. Next steps: javier to open INC-2026-142-PR with actions and timeline.

javier (SRE): Created INC-2026-142 in JIRA with tasks and owners. Will attach logs and timeline later.

anna (Infra): dedicated-0 is drained and marked back to normal at 17:58 UTC. Runtime override expires in 1h; will validate policy revert before expiration.

mike (SRE): Thanks team. Handoff complete.

javier (SRE): Acknowledged.
